opening.argument: The speaker presents a purported 1 Lac withdrawal as a one-day earning, saying, “Thank God I just got 1 Lac withdrawal from FORCEIGT BUSD you can see 1 Lac withdrawal in my hand.” He then makes recruitment the requested action: “if you want to become a part of our team if you want to join us.” The displayed banknotes, WhatsApp contact number, and identification as “MY SELF INAMULLAH FORSAGE SENIOR LEADER” reinforce that team-leader framing. Taken together, these are not merely personal earnings described for information; they form a recruitment-centered earning solicitation directing viewers to contact him and join.
